method: Hand-written single-best-answer MCQs grounded only in the accepted open full text.

topic.coverageNote: Open JABFM review of pars defects, isthmic slip, Meyerding grades, and conservative care. Degenerative spondylolisthesis is named in the classification but is not the focus.

mcqs.question: What is spondylolysis, as defined in this review?

options.A: An anatomic defect of the pars interarticularis, typically from repetitive loading in extension and rotation
options.C: Forward slip from a degenerative facet joint without a pars defect

mcqs.correctAnswerText: An anatomic defect of the pars interarticularis, typically from repetitive loading in extension and rotation
mcqs.explanation: Spondylolysis is an anatomic defect of the pars interarticularis, typically a stress reaction and fracture from repetitive lumbar loading in extension and rotation.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Journal of the American Board of Family Medicine
sourceRefs.excerpt: Spondylolysis is the term used to describe an anatomic defect of the pars interarticularis, which typically results from stress reaction and subsequent fracture as a result of repetitive loading of the lumbar spine in extension and rotation

mcqs.question: When does this review use the term isthmic spondylolisthesis?

options.A: Forward translation of one vertebra on the next when pars defects are bilateral
options.C: A unilateral pars defect with no translation

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Forward translation of one vertebra on the next when pars defects are bilateral
mcqs.explanation: With bilateral pars defects, forward translation of one vertebra on the next caudal segment is isthmic spondylolisthesis. The review treats the two as a continuum.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Journal of the American Board of Family Medicine
sourceRefs.excerpt: In the setting of bilateral pars interarticularis defects, forward translation of 1 vertebra relative to the next caudal vertebral segment may occur, which is termed isthmic spondylolisthesis

mcqs.question: How does the Meyerding system grade a slip?

options.A: Grade I is 0–25%, II 25–50%, III 50–75%, IV 75–100%, and grade V is greater than 100% (spondyloptosis)
options.B: Grades are based only on pain scores
options.C: Grade I is a complete slip off the sacrum
options.D: There are two grades: stable and unstable

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Grade I is 0–25%, II 25–50%, III 50–75%, IV 75–100%, and grade V is greater than 100% (spondyloptosis)
mcqs.explanation: The article states grade I 0% to 25%, II 25% to 50%, III 50% to 75%, IV 75% to 100%, and grade V greater than 100%, called spondyloptosis.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Journal of the American Board of Family Medicine
sourceRefs.excerpt: 0% to 25% is Grade I, 25% to 50% is Grade II, 50% to 75% is Grade III, 75% to 100% is Grade IV, and greater than 100% is Grade V, which is referred to as spondyloptosis

mcqs.question: What initial treatment does the review say helps most patients?

options.A: Activity restriction, physical therapy, and bracing
options.B: Immediate fusion for every pars defect
options.D: Strict bed rest for six months without therapy
options.E: Traction as the only conservative method

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Activity restriction, physical therapy, and bracing
mcqs.explanation: The majority of patients improve with conservative therapy including activity restriction, physical therapy, and bracing. Others need surgery for persistent symptoms.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Journal of the American Board of Family Medicine
sourceRefs.excerpt: the majority of patients improve with conservative therapy including activity restriction, physical therapy and bracing, others require operative intervention due to persistent symptoms

mcqs.question: Which classification does the review cite for broad etiologies that include isthmic, dysplastic, degenerative, post-traumatic, and pathologic slips?

options.B: Meyerding, which is an etiology system

mcqs.explanation: The Wiltse-Newman classification categorizes spondylolisthesis by etiology, including isthmic, dysplastic, degenerative, post-traumatic, and pathologic. Meyerding grades the amount of slip.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Journal of the American Board of Family Medicine
sourceRefs.excerpt: The Wiltse-Newman classification categorizes spondylolisthesis under broad etiologies which include isthmic, dysplastic, degenerative, post-traumatic and pathologic
